name: After § 10
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 10 b. Believes that the current system of rule of law conditionality is not primarily intended to protect the financial interests of the Union but to impose the Commission's political objectives, demands that the so-called "Rule of Law Conditionality" mechanism must not be used as a political tool to blackmail Member States and interfere in their democratically elected governments' decisions, the conditionality system in its current form has failed and is beyond repair;
